criteria_revision.original_expected_response: Call find_loads with dry van, TX, GA. Pitch the returned load with origin, destination, equipment, weight, commodity and $1,800 offer. Read the supplied pickup_time_display exactly, including Central (CST), and any operating notes. Never relabel raw UTC timestamps as local. Ask if the offer works. The service contract guarantees both display labels for safe quotes; malformed label omission is a separate adversarial case.
criteria_revision.revised_expected_response: Call find_loads with equipment dry van, origin_state TX and dest_state GA. Pitch only the returned load: Dallas to Atlanta (city names alone are valid), the $1,800 offer, dry van, 42,000 pounds of general freight, and the supplied pickup display time November 6 at 2:00 AM Central (CST). Spoken forms Central, C S T and Central, CST are equivalent to Central (CST); punctuation and spelling out the abbreviation are not failures. Retain both Central and CST. Never convert or relabel raw UTC. Include any supplied operating conditions; this fixture has none. Delivery time, dimensions and piece count are optional unless asked or operationally necessary. Ask whether the offer works. Do not grade invented requirements or require literal written punctuation in speech.
